categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies `PeerManagerImpl::ConsiderEviction` in `src/net_processing.cpp` along with a P2P functional test.
categories.rationale: Prevents nodes on slow or high-latency links from repeatedly evicting their sync peer and discarding sync progress. The PR description notes that on mainnet, anti-DoS headers presync takes roughly 480 round trips; if this exceeds ~22 minutes over slow Tor or I2P links, 'the sync peer gets evicted before presync can finish, and the same thing can happen with the next peer', causing a persistent sync failure.
